summary: Learn to assess service demand, capacity and resource gaps using practical healthcare analytics. Explore the five-day course and plan your next step.
lede: Healthcare resource allocation analytics helps planners use service and operational data to compare demand with available capacity, staffing, supplies and budgets. For healthcare planners, facility operations teams and health finance professionals, the course covers checking data quality, calculating bed occupancy and length of stay, comparing staffing with workload, and turning findings into an allocation brief through Excel exercises using illustrative data.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who use health service, facility, workforce or expenditure data to plan where limited resources can support essential services. It is designed for foundation-level learners who need practical allocation tools rather than programming instruction.
modules: Healthcare Resource Planning with WHO Building Blocks
SARA Service Availability and Readiness Measures
WHO-CHOICE Service Mix and Cost Priorities
Bed Occupancy and Patient Flow Measures
Scenario Analysis for Budget and Equity
prerequisites: Prerequisites: No prior analytics or programming experience is required. A basic familiarity with healthcare services or operational planning is useful. Participants should be comfortable reviewing tables and using a spreadsheet; coding is not required. Advanced cost-effectiveness concepts receive conceptual coverage only.
